preconditions.description: The dimensions of the field must be within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The number of teleporters k matches the number of teleporter entries.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x1 <= n and 1 <= y1 <= m and 1 <= x2 <= n and 1 <= y2 <= m for x1, y1, x2, y2 in teleporters)
postconditions.description: All teleporter coordinates are within the field boundaries.
The path length is exactly n*m + 1 steps.
The path starts and ends at the capital (1, 1).

postconditions.expression: all((x, y) in path for x in range(1, n + 1) for y in range(1, m + 1))
postconditions.description: Every square in the field is visited exactly once except the capital.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(path[i][0] - path[i + 1][0]) + abs(path[i][1] - path[i + 1][1]) <= 2 for i in range(len(path) - 1))
postconditions.description: Each step in the path is either a direct move or a teleportation.
